Trace, implement and test: Candidate

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Candidate {
    private String name;
    private String gender;
    private double expectedSalary;

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    public void setName(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getGender() {
        return gender;
    }

    public void setGender(String gender) {
        this.gender = gender;
    }

    public double getExpectedSalary() {
        return expectedSalary;
    }

    public void setExpectedSalary(double expectedSalary) {
        this.expectedSalary = expectedSalary;
    }
}
